question: Should the stricter provider-native validation and authentication behavior replace Crabline's previously permissive behavior in this release?
rationale: The direction matches repository policy, but the patch changes externally observable acceptance and delivery behavior across several providers, so maintainers must explicitly own the compatibility boundary.

options.title: Land strict fidelity
options.body: Accept the compatibility change after representative client evidence is reviewed and the PR metadata and changelog edit are corrected.

options.title: Stage compatibility
options.body: Preserve permissive behavior where practical and introduce stricter validation through an explicit migration or configuration path.

options.title: Split the hardening
options.body: Land recorder and low-risk fixes separately while deferring provider behaviors whose compatibility impact remains uncertain.

recommendation.title: Land strict fidelity
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility change after representative client evidence is reviewed and the PR metadata and changelog edit are corrected.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository member currently carrying the focused cross-provider hardening work and the best evidenced owner available for this choice.
